facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: The prince told his story. A witch cursed him. Kindness broke the spell. He became a handsome prince.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: The prince explained that a witch had cursed him long ago. Only true kindness could break the magic spell. He became a handsome prince thanks to the princess. Her genuine friendship melted the witch's dark magic. The prince was from a kingdom far away. He thanked the princess for giving him a second chance.
facts.Word cards: became = 됐다 / handsome = 잘생긴 / spell = 마법 / shone = 빛났다
